# Mallet (the player's, orange): a wide disc with a raised rim, a short handle and a ball knob, 0.44 across,
# 0.32 tall; origin at the bottom centre (the game slides it on the playing surface).
# Generated by make_env.py. Up Z.
new
material new Body --base-color 0.7686 0.3961 0.1098 --no-slot
material new Knob --base-color 0.9529 0.7608 0.1255 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Disc --vertices 12 --radius 0.22 --depth 0.08 --location 0 0 0.04
material assign Body
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
inset 0.06
translate 0 0 -0.03
mode object
add mesh cylinder --name Handle --vertices 8 --radius 0.075 --depth 0.16 --location 0 0 0.13
material assign Body
add mesh ico-sphere --name Ball --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.105 --location 0 0 0.23
material assign Knob
select Disc Handle Ball
active Disc
join
shade flat
export mallet_p.glb
